segments.oily: Reviewers with oily, oily/combination, or acne-prone skin report the scrub clears buildup, blackheads, and pore congestion, with several calling it especially suited to oilier skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including winter dry patches, report it polishes and softens without excessive dryness, though one warns it can be drying if used too often without a moisturizer.
segments.combination: Reviewers describing combination skin report it works well for both previous and current formulas, leaving skin smooth without issue.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: some say it is gentle enough and causes no issues or irritation, while others explicitly warn the scrub is too abrasive for delicate or sensitive skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers with aging or mature skin report improved texture, reduced dullness, and less visible pores with regular use.
segments.normal: One reviewer with naturally good skin reports it fits into a hydration and anti-aging routine, leaving skin fresh and soft.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for aging or mature skin report smoother texture, less dullness, and fewer visible pores over time; no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry patches report the scrub polishes without stripping and even helped dry patches disappear; one reviewer cautions it could dry out skin if overused or if skin is not naturally oily.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports the product is gentle and works well despite sensitivity; no negative reports on redness are present.
concerns.barrier: No specific barrier-related complaints or benefits are described in the reviews.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report reduced blackheads and clearer pores, including one describing all blackheads gone after two days; no dissent noted.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or closed-comedone skin report clearer skin and fewer breakouts, sometimes combined with other treatments; one long-term acne-prone user reports the new formula performs worse and doesn't suit her skin as well as the original.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers with oily skin report it manages excess oil and buildup effectively, especially in the T-zone; no negative reports on oiliness are present.

extraits.texte: Exfoliating Scrub is part of my daily cleansing routine and absolutely necessary for my super oily, acne prone skin. I've been using it for at least a decade. I recently got a new bottle and it is not the same! It is more like the 7 Day Scrub now. It is creamier and has less scrub in it and my skin is NOT liking it. The original formula was perfect. Why mess with a good thing??

I refuse to dock this product just because I can't use it anymore. In my 20s, I would no more miss a day using my beloved face scrub than I would have skipped brushing my teeth. My skin used to be thick and strong and oily in the T zone. Fast forward 30 years (because that's what it felt like!), and my skin can no longer handle physical scrubs, as it has become more thin and sensitive. I developed rosacea in my mid 30s (which I keep calm using Clinique's other skincare products) and I eventually started using retinoids. I realize that Clinique still sells chemical exfoliants in its Clarifying Lotions, and some of the serums contain actives, but it seems the focus is on BHA (salicylic acid) when I would love to see a dedicated AHA glycolic leave-on exfoliant. Meanwhile, this scrub was true love while it lasted, and it didn't seem to suffer in quality or effectiveness through its reformulation(s).

I was a little nervous after seeing some of the reviews of the new formula, but I'm happy to say this is still an excellent scrub. It's a strong scrub, so not one to use if you have rather delicate skin. Unfortunately, my skin is oily and acne prone and has large pores, so I need a substantial scrub, and this one meets my needs. I can absolutely tell the difference in the texture of my skin if I go too long without it! As a side note-- if you are like me and had to give up your grocery store scrub because you or someone in your house has been diagnosed with a tree nut allergy, this is a great solution. I was having a hard time finding a scrub that exfoliated as well as the ones with walnut shell powder, but this one absolutely does the trick, and now I don't have to worry that my face scrub is going to make my daughter go into anaphylaxis.

I have very oily, acne-prone skin. This exfoliator has been great. I really how you can feel the grit without it being too abrasive. This product doesn't dry me out or irritate my skin; in fact, my face feels so smooth after I use it! Definitely cleanses well and it may have even been helping with hormonal acne I have on my cheeks. I'm really glad I found this product.

I jut got it 2 days ago and so far love it. My skin was like sandpaper but feels nice and soft after using it. I have rosacea and this is very gentle for my skin yet exfoliates very well. Also, it seems as this tube will last forever, it's a paste consistency, very efficient.

extraits.titre: Not the same, but still pretty great!
extraits.texte: I've been using Clinique products for more than thirty years, and agree with other recent reviewers that it's not the same as it used to be, but honestly it's still great. I use it 1 to 2 times per week and it really makes a difference in the texture of my aging skin, it's less dull and my pores aren't as noticeable as when I get lazy and don't use it.

extraits.titre: Honestly I have yet to find Any even comparable!❤️
extraits.texte: I LOVE this product! I have gone through so many trying to find one similar, and NONE come close! Has the PERFECT amount of little gritty scrubbies for deep clean feeling. Could dry out your skin if used too often or you don't naturally have oily skin, or without a moisturizer. The only downside I can say is that Clinique products are only sold at select stores, and a little on the expensive side. But after using it, It's worth the $. Everyone has certain things they love and can't be substituted, this is one of those items for me. I have BAD breakouts more as an adult than ALL of my teen years combined, I think due to hormone levels.. if you're wanting a good facial scrub with the nitty-grittys like soft sandpaper ;) ..it gently removes that layer of yuck you don't want and leaves your skin soft, smooth, and CLEAN.❤️❤️❤️
